explanation_full: The XGBoost model demonstrated a strong performance on the dataset, achieving an R2 score of 0.7495. Furthermore, the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) was 0.0956, suggesting a relatively low average prediction error. The model's diagnostics also reported a linear fit slope of 0.8387 and a maximum absolute residual of 0.4105.
